tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi zhi ba'i sreg blugs cho ga dngos grub skyes bzang 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ye shes zhi ba'i rang bzhin 'pho min yang*// thabs mkhas khro bo 'bar ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// gdul dka' 'dul mchog lag na rdo rje dang*// tha dad med pa dpal ldan bla mas skyongs// gang de'i gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod kyi// snying po dngos grub zung gi gya nom skyes// bde blag nyid du 'dren byed sreg blugs kyi// phrin las cho ga'i shing rta mngon par bskrun// de la 'di'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang rjes so// dang po ni/ zhi ba'i thab khung dbus nas khru phyed kyis zlum por bskor ba'i phyi nas kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi bzhis bskor ba'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang phyi rol gyi stegs bu'i grwar zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po bya/ nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su mtshan ma dgod/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing zlum por brtsigs/ shar lhor me tshang bzhag nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan dang*/ mdun du me yol pha gu la dkar zhal gyis byug pa dang*/ bsang chu 'thor yab rdo rje dril bu/ de'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar ba/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad rnams bsham// sgrub pa po yi g.yas logs nas// yam shing mar til zas mchog dang*// so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni// sran ma dūrba ku sha'o// g.yon nas nyer spyod 'das gtor dang*// me lha'i gtor ma bcas pa bshams// de nas phyi ma red kyi dus su gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan te zhi ba'i sems dang ldan zhing kha shar tu phyogs pas skyil krung ngam rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis stan la 'khod do// dngos gzhi la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan bsdu ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa ltar bsgom mo// 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo// dpal 'bar rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'i me sbar te lag pa gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ces lan gsum brjod cing oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes pas me tshang du gzhug la rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas me gso/

de nas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung ste blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg pa dang bcas te bud shing la khyab par blugs te oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ bsang chu la oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas rdzas rnams la gtor te sngags de nyid kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che la grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon nas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās sbyangs/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas shab+da bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thab la dmigs te oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor la/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par bsam/ thab kyi nang du me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gun+dhe 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/

gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyis dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya byas pa rna ba'i drung du g.yob cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+ni ma hā te dzaḥsarba karmā pra sā dha kaḥkā ru ṇ+ya kri ta sarba ār+tha asmin+san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyang drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig par bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngar ltar spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs nas rnam par 'dud/ ces pas bstod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni sogs nas zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa a zhes brjod de/ thab kyi mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor gyis dgram mo// de nas bsang chus phyogs kun du gtor zhing*/

a mṛ te brjod pas bgegs bsal lo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsam ste/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun brjod cing*/ mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā di pyā di pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul lo// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā zhes pas yam shing lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs gang 'byor phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā zhes gdags/ sbyin bdag gi don du bya ba'i tshe spel tshig kha bsgyur shes par bya'o// de bzhin du sde tshan re re'i mtshams su spel tshig sbyar ba dang bcas te oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar dang*/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til lam yungs kar dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zas mchog dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swā hās 'bras so ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hās 'bras dang*/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūrba dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul te mthar mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar ltar byas la/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu phul te badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/

me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam zhing brjod do// de nas 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig sogs nas/ 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i spos reng thogs te/ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta ḍa ma ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar ro// de'i mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar dang bcas par 'gyur ces dang*/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing brjod la/ gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du dmigs la/ gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ces pa lan 'ga' zhig brjod pa'i mar khu/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun du mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā di pyā di pya sogs swā hā'i bar dang bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i la sogs pa'i spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon skyems phul/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs nas rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa rnams sarba ta thā ga ta'i rjes su bhū ta ḍa ma ra sa pa ri wā ra btags pa ma gtogs kun rig ltar bya'o// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/

gzhom zhig bral ba mtha' bral stong pa'i dngos// rdo rje'i gur khyim mtho zhing rab yangs par// dus mtha'i zhugs 'dra ye shes me yis 'khyud// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal la 'dud// 'khor ba'i skyon bral dri med pad+ma dang*// snying rje'i zla bas rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor la// srid gsum 'byung po gnon pa'i dpa' bo'i sku// mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs su 'bar la 'dud// rtsa phyag 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyag rgya bsnol// yid srub klad pa 'gems pa'i rdo rje g.yas// bgegs dpung gzhob tu bsreg cing dbang sdud pa'i// cig shos sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams la 'dud// gdug pa'i tshogs btul dam la rab gnas phyir// lag 'gro'i dbang pos rab brgyan sems can gyi// re ba 'gengs pa'i nor bu'i rgyan cha dang*// ye shes lnga bdag thod phreng can la 'dud// rang gi rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur mtshon pa'i// mi bskyod thod dang dar gyi stod g.yogs sngo// stag lpags sar pa'i dpa' mtshan sham bur dkris// bden gnyis zhabs ldan 'dor stabs 'gying la 'dud// gsung mchog sngags kyi rgyal po 'bar ba'i mes// gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tsher skam rab bsregs nas// dngos grub 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta can// mkhyen dang brtse ba bsam mi khyab la 'dud// mthu stobs mchog gis che ba'i lha khyod la// cung zad bstod pas bdag dang sems can kun// bar chad mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal te// gsang gsum mi phyed rdo rje mngon gyur cig /ces pas bstod do// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re'i thog mar snying po tshar gsum gyis mngon par bsngags te rdzas sngags so sos brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar sbyar ro// de nas til mdun du 'dus byas pa la bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib thams cad thim pa slar ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la snying po yi ge bzhi pa 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig btags te til bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha 'bul/

sgrub g.yog gcig gi me rgyun ma chad tsam gyis mar dang yam shing 'jug bsreg rdzas rdzogs pa dang byon skyems kyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū ta ḍa ma ra sa pa ri wā ra re sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ 'das pa'i gtor ma rjes gnang gi yi ge ltar byin gyis brlabs nas phul te mchod cing bstod la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don gyi gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba cung zad blangs pa dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/ me lha zhal phyag can gyi rnam par gyur par bsam zhing brjod la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa phul mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su 'bul/ de nas me lha'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro zhes sogs lan gsum mam lngas phul/

mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar bas mchod la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod la/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags lhag chad du gyur pa'i nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don gyi 'phrin las zhus la/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+ne gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed la/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam gang shes dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// me mnal ba dang thal ba phyags la rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung la sogs par dor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas btub bo// thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri bzang po'i chus byugs la me tog gi char phab ste bkra shis bya'o// cho ga 'dis ni 'das pa'i me lha dang mtshan sngags bstod pa rnams kha bsgyur bas phyag na rdo rje gzhan rnams kyi cho ga'ang 'grub bo// smras pa/ brgyud ldan mkhyen pa'i mig gsum ral pa na// legs par gab pa'i sreg blugs lha chu'i rgyun// don gnyer rig byed smra ba'i sgrib sbyong du// bdag blo'i bha gi rā thas 'di na phab// spyi 'gro bde ba'i lam du rkang pa bkod// khyad par ma 'dres 'phrang la legs 'grims nas// las rab 'dod pa'i khang par son pa'i bu// 'jigs pa med par 'gying de blo ldan yin// de las byung ba'i legs byas pa sangs dang*// kun+da'i phon ltar dkar bas bdag dang gzhan// sngags spyod gser gyi 'khor los sgyur mkhas pas// rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal srid zin par shog

/ces dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi zhi ba'i sreg blugs cho ga dngos grub skyes bzang 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbu mdzad bla ma kun dga' bsod nams kyi gsung gis bskul ngor/ sngags rig smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwar sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// swasti/ dri bzhon gyis bskyod byi ru'i 'khri shing ni// gzhon nu ltar mdzes rdo rje btsun mo dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs sen gtsug bkod de// mar me la brten sreg blugs gsal bar 'dri// 'dir gang zhig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul la gsum las sbyor ba ni mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du/ mar me'i kong bu yangs pa la ras dmar pos dkris pa'i sdong bu sbom po btsugs nas/ mar dkar gyi khu bas bkang ba bzhag gtor ma yang bsham/ ma 'byor na yid kyis bsams kyang rung*/ bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo til dang nang mchod rdo rje dril bu sogs kyang bsham/ dngos gzhi ni bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang*/ yang na thun mtshams kyi rje btsun mar skad cig gis dran par byas te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ sum+bha nas bsang*/ swa bhā was/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi mjug tu dharma ra ṇi rol mo bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas ngag tu oṃ gsum ma dang oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes pas mar me sbar la/ mar me bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e yig nyis brtsegs las byung ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

baṃ yig dmar po'i mtha' skor du oṃ sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍī ka'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sogs nas gnyis su med par thim pa'i bar gyis mar me lhar bskyed/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gī ni re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ shab+da'i bar rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags te/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod cing*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad sbyong ba'i las mdzad par gyur ces brjod do// de nas til la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad snying ga nas yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas 'thon/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa til la thim par bsams la/ mtheb srin gyis til nas blangs te/ rje btsun ma'i zhal du phul bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yi ge phal cher las sngags 'di kho na ltar byung zhing*/ bla ma phyi ma 'ga' zhig ni/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsungs te gang ltar yang brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus su phul ba'i mthar/ mchod bstod gong ltar byas/ gtor ma yod na byin gyis brlabs pa dang 'bul ba sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// rjes ni thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bdag la bsdu/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ rang gi gnas rnams su sogs kyis srung ba rnams byed/ dge ba bsngo zhing 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs kyis smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan te/ mar me mnal ba dang ro ma rnams chu bo'am sa gtsang sar dor/ 'di la 'bad pa byas na sdig pa thams cad 'byong ba dang rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs khyad par can du 'gyur bar gsungs so// smras pa/ sa skya'i bla chen las 'ongs gser gyi chos// gong ma'i gsung don tshig gi rgyud mangs glur// nye bar blangs pa'i lam nas gsal byas pa// 'di la 'gal dang ma 'brel med par sems// snang byed chung ngu bteg pa'i 'phral de la// stug po'i mun pa'i rang gzugs 'jig pa ltar// tshegs chung thabs kyis dpag yas sdig za bar// bsngags pa'i bden pas 'gro la phan byed shog /de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sreg blugs kyi ngag 'don nyung ngu rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong bsod nams legs grub kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bris pa dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
